ignorePatterns:
dist/
ui/dist/
node_modules/
bun.lock
mise.lock
THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md

rules.rule: A PR that adds, splits, renames, or deletes a file under doc/agents/ must update the .greptile/ wiring in the same PR: every files.json entry pointing at a moved or removed file, and a new entry in the .greptile/ folder for whichever subtree a new file governs. Flag the PR when a doc/agents/*.md path is added, renamed, or deleted and no files.json changed alongside it.
